overview.text: Leverage Blockchain Outsourcing Services from Setia. Using quality-improved methodologies to work with issuing and managing digital assets in order to certify Authenticity, Quantity, Ownership and Age of Items.

platform.subtitle: Business blocks as additional components to empower and accelerate your business
platform.imageAlt: Digital Assets Management Platform architecture — S-API, S-Gateway, S-Notary, S-View layers

item0.title: Built-in Stellar
item0.description: A leading platform built on Stellar Blockchain. Each asset is tokenized ensuring a single entry into the Marketplace.

item1.title: Securitized Assets
item1.description: Each asset can be investigated from any Stellar Network Explorer to assert its authenticity.

item2.title: Marketplace and Digital Collections
item2.description: For each asset customers can choose whether to keep it or put it in the Marketplace at a set price.

item3.title: Rarity Factor
item3.description: The rarity of each asset is defined by a counter and well defined set of rules. Customers can check the actual quantity on any Stellar explorer.

item4.title: Concurrency Management
item4.description: The platform implements channels to manage blockchain transactions assigning time in seconds.

item5.title: Non-Fungible Tokens
item5.description: The platform supports non-fungible token trading, making the assets similar to the Ethereum standard ERC-721 / ERC-1155.
